post.title: How Canva makes $4B when almost 9 in 10 users pay nothing
post.ig:
Almost 9 in 10 Canva users pay nothing. Canva still says it's cash-flow positive.
Canva says it reached $4B in annual recurring revenue by the end of 2025, with 265M+ monthly users and 31M+ paid users.
Our math: $4B / 31M = about $129 per paying user a year. Accounts with 25+ seats doubled to $500M ARR (Canva).
Canva says it has been free cash flow profitable every year since 2017, though its filed accounts in Australia have shown losses. In August 2026 it reportedly cut its 2026 growth forecast to 20%, citing AI costs.
Sources: TechCrunch (Feb 2026, Canva COO Cliff Obrecht), Fortune (Aug 2025, Aug 2026). Canva is private; figures are company-reported and unaudited.
